question_stem:
A spring balance is used to weigh a cylinder that is immersed in oil, as shown in Fig. 4.1.

{{figure:9702_s16_23_q04_figure_4_1}}

Fig. 4.1

The reading on the spring balance is $4.8\text{N}$. The length of the cylinder is $5.0\text{cm}$ and the cross-sectional area of the cylinder is $13\text{cm}^2$. The weight of the cylinder is $5.3\text{N}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: The cylinder is in equilibrium when it is immersed in the oil. Explain this in terms of the forces acting on the cylinder.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Calculate the density of the oil.
